newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia coffee prices easier, interest thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia coffee prices easier, interest thin.

text.p: Indonesian Robusta coffee prices were easier on Monday following declines in London futures last Friday, while buying interest remained limited, traders said.
They said the local price was quoted at 2,600-2,650 rupiah/kg in the key growing region of Lampung in South Sumatra, compared with 2,650-2,700 rupiah a week ago.
The export price was also marginally down to $1,200/tonne from $1,200-$1,210 fob Lampung last week.
London Robusta futures made losses in late trading last Friday on persistent fund and trade long liquidation coupled with nervousness over origin selling.
"The market is very quiet, with only some players who have contracts to fill doing short covering," one Lampung trader said. "Trade is also thin because of declining stocks."
"Stocks are becoming smaller and there doesn't seem to be much interest in the market after the harvest," he said.
Traders also said that comparatively cheaper Vietnamese coffee was adding to the market gloom.
"Vietnamese coffee is being quoted at $1,020-$1,040/tonne. The discount is just too much for us to compete with Vietnam. But I hear there's been plenty of rain in Vietnam," one trader said.
